description: The window's input (docs/plans/autonomy.md → Merges): one PR per stack, labelled with its tier, written on Monday mornings only and left alone the rest of the week, so the evening review and the window see one fixed commit. Renovate never merges. A release whose time the registry gives waits its age here; one with none (every ghcr.io, quay.io and lscr.io image, several of docker.io's, every digest) waits in skynet-merge, 3 days from the PR's newest commit.

customManagers.description: Container images pinned in Nix (virtualisation.oci-containers): image = "<name>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>";

packageRules.description: Meilisearch follows karakeep's own pin (its docker/docker-compose.yml): a newer one can't open the index without a migration

mcp-victoriametrics's tag v1.120.1 is v1.20.1 tagged wrong: its revision label is v1.20.1's commit, built a month before v1.20.2, and upstream has no such release. Moving to it would be a downgrade
A release's age, where the registry gives its time: 3 days for a digest or patch
One PR per stack, so a PR is what verify checks and a rollback undoes (a major gets its own). Tier A: the window merges it
Tier B, a host's: the flake's inputs and the images pinned in Nix (doco-cd, Apprise). Each its own PR
The weekly flake.lock is a host change too
Tier C, Ali's: Unraid's exporters, which he applies, and CI's actions, which are code-owned
